idea-plugin.name: Fluffy Cursor
idea-plugin.description:
Fluffy Cursor — an open-source animated caret

A responsive editor caret with directional stretching, subtle neon glow, and one gentle forward/back landing recoil. Typing uses a faster, lighter effect. Ghost copies, particles, ripple, and landing pulse are disabled by default.

Open Settings → Tools → Fluffy Cursor, choose a preset, pick your color, and tune motion and glow. Higher spring stiffness feels quicker; a thin resting caret keeps text readable.

Built with Kotlin, Swing, and common IntelliJ Platform APIs. A clipped glass-pane overlay draws the caret; elapsed-time spring physics makes motion independent of fixed 60 Hz steps. Animation timers stop after settlement. The native caret is restored when the effect is disabled.

The JetBrains plugin does not modify IDE installation files. The separate VS Code / Code OSS edition does modify desktop workbench interface files for full effects; it is an unsupported, reversible customization with its own installation guide.

Open source under the MIT license. Inspect, modify, and contribute at GitHub. No telemetry or remote rendering scripts are included. Unaffiliated with JetBrains or Microsoft.

Supported platform range: 2024.3–2026.2. API compatibility was verified on IDEA and PyCharm 2026.2.3 and Rider 2026.2.3.1. Actual frame rate depends on IDE and system load; Linux/macOS visual behavior has not been manually verified.
